open_points.subject: R0-15 token coverage
open_points.text: every operation on a project needs the token
open_points.question: Which actions count as operations on a project, specifically deliver-one-photo, record-publication, and writing or changing an object's folder connection, and what authentication is required for actions outside that category?
options: All three deliverer operations and all connection-record writes require the token.
Only scan is project-level; photo delivery and publication recording do not require the token.
The three deliverer operations require the token, but connection-record administration uses separate authentication.
The token is required only when an operation mutates or reads Portal data.
open_points.default_guess: Treat every operation that reads, writes or derives data for a Registry project—including all three deliverer operations and connection-record writes—as on that project and require the token.

witness.initial: An object has no confirmed folder connection, and the agent has the project id and folder paths.
events: The agent attempts to write the object's connection record without the token.
outcomes: The write is rejected because changing the connection is an operation on a project.
The write succeeds because connection administration is not one of the deliverer's project operations.
witness.observer: The agent and the owner waiting for delivery to become enabled
